Name: HIT_EFFECT_SFX_CONCEPT_PARAM_ST
Description: Hit effect particles for each defending material. The row is the material being hit; each attack material has two slots (1 and 2), both of which play when an attack of that material hits.

Fields.Name: 1: Kinetic
Fields.Description: Hit effect played when an iron (kinetic) attack hits this material. Used for kinetic blades and bullets. Slot 1 of 2; both slots play.

Fields.Name: 2: Kinetic
Fields.Description: Hit effect played when an iron (kinetic) attack hits this material. Used for kinetic blades and bullets. Slot 2 of 2; both slots play.
